# Review, pass 1 — kebra-nagast-ch100b (ch. 100, part 2 of 2)

Reviewer pass 1. Edited `units.json` in place by script (valid JSON, same schema; every `t` and every `p` verified
unchanged against the original). `gloss.json` not opened or edited. No modern translation consulted. Dillmann
unavailable; the one external control used is the pinned source itself (Bezold/HaCohen, all chapters) as a
concordance, and the published entries in `known-forms.json`. Units are numbered from 0, as in the drafter's notes
(unit 0 = ወሶበ ከመዝ ተመክሑ …; unit 25 = ወአነ እቄድሶ …; unit 26 = ዘንተኬ ተኀሥሥ …).

Format of entries: unit · field · severity · what was wrong · what was done.

## Changes

### Whole part
- top · titleEn, part · minor · "Fallen Watchers" is an Enochic term the Geʿez does not use (it says መላእክት) · now "Fallen Angels".
- top · about · minor · said the closing address was "to Israel" and that the giants "bring on the flood" · now: address to Moses and through him the people; giants marked (?); the flood is God's wrath over them and the sinners.

### Unit 0
- 0 · l/i · moderate · ተይ and መርቄ were rendered "smoke" and "gloom" with nothing behind them (the note itself says guesses) · both left untranslated, (?) kept. Concordance: ተይ recurs in ch. 101 as a cosmic element beside fire, wind and water; መርቄ is already unplaced in the published parts (ch. 35, 78). No grammar settles either.
- 0 · n, l · moderate · እምከመ called 'if' in the note though i has "Since" (and the word is 'since, once' with a perfect elsewhere: ch. 18, 37, 58, 69) · note and l corrected to 'since-indeed-then'.
- 0 · l/i · minor · "cannot be loosed or broken" adds a modal the negative imperfect does not carry; l "break" · now "are not loosed or broken".
- 0 · n · minor · ምንባሪክሙ explained as መንበር/ምንባር + ክሙ; ምንባሪ- is the regular suffix stem of ምንባር (ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን, ch. 45, 62) · note corrected.

### Unit 2
- 2 · n · moderate · note said the angels "overcame God's word" and are overcome in unit 11; the text says no such thing (and the note on unit 11 says the opposite) · rewritten to point to the verbs' return in units 4 and 11.
- 2 · l/i/n · minor · ተኀየለ rendered "overpowered" without a hedge, though the published entry reads the same form 'prevailed, grew strong' · (?) added in l and i; note tells the glosser to broaden.

### Unit 3
- 3 · l/i · moderate · ዘያሠርጽ rendered "he who sows" / "that he sows a thought": ዘ is 'that which', and no "a thought" is in the text · "except only what he sows into the mind".
- 3 · l/i/n · moderate · ይትዋሣእ 'take by force' unsupported by the form: tä- + long ā is reciprocal, the root is that of አውሥአ 'answer' (100a); published sense of the family is 'answer/dispute' · now "dispute (?)", note rewritten.
- 3 · l · minor · በጽምሚት 'in-secrecy' in l, 'silently' in i, 'in silence/secretly' in the note; the published entry is 'in silence, secrecy' · l now 'in-silence(?)', note aligned.

### Unit 4
- 4 · n · minor · (?) added to ተሠጥወ (not attested elsewhere); ምዝጋና noted as unattested elsewhere (kept "glory (?)", see unresolved).

### Unit 5
- 5 · l/n · moderate · ልበ እጓለ እመሕያው glossed 'offspring of the living' · እመሕያው is እም 'mother' + ሕያው (the published entry) → l "offspring-of mother-of-the-living", note corrected.
- 5 · i · minor · "came down" (ወወረዲ, a non-standard ending, only (?) in l) given without a hedge in i · (?) added.
- 5 · l/i · minor · "dance" for ዘፍኖሙ stated flatly (ዘፈነ in ch. 6 is 'dance/sing') · (?) added in l and i; ch. 6 cited.
- 5 · i/l · minor · "all their arts at which they labored" · "all their craft in which they busied themselves (?)", l (?) added; note links ተኬነዉ with ተኬነወ of 100a unit 9 and unit 11 (one glossary entry for all three).
- 5 · n · minor · "God grants their wish … which is the fall itself" is interpretation presented as fact · softened to a hedged sense.
- 5 · n · minor · ተሠርሙ: added that -ሙ is the pronoun (cf. ተውህቦሙ), not the perfect plural ending, hence perhaps an impersonal passive; unattested elsewhere.
- 5 · n · minor · ይባቤ: parallel in ch. 39 (በውውዓ በትፍሥሕት ወበይባቤ) added.

### Unit 6
- 6 · n · moderate · the three verbs were each described separately as "uncertain"; the grammar fixes them as 3rd feminine plural perfects with the women as subject (like ሀለዋ; አደማሆሙ = አደመ + -ኣ + ሆሙ), so ሆካ takes ኅሊናሆሙ as object · note rewritten; the lexical guesses stay (?).

### Unit 7
- 7 · i · minor · "each took for himself … the women he had chosen" turned the plural verb and ዘዘ into a singular distributive · "took for themselves … women, each one whom they had chosen".
- 7 · n · minor · ዘዘ called a possible printing doubling; it is the ordinary distributive (ዘዘ ዓመት, ch. 47; published entry) · note corrected.

### Unit 8
- 8 · i · moderate · the Gospel saying ("Woe to those …") had no quotation marks though introduced by ይብል · “ ” added (ends at ቢጾሙ).

### Unit 9
- 9 · i · moderate · "And again he said: God loves the humble …" ran on into the narrator's "And then God was angry", so the quotation boundary was unreadable · “ ” added, ends at ርእሶሙ.
- 9 · l/i/n · moderate · ያኀስሮሙ (causative of ኀሰረ 'lack') rendered "impoverishes" in l and "brings low" in i — the latter is remembered Luke wording, and l and i disagreed · "causes-them-loss" / "diminishes those who make themselves great"; note says why.
- 9 · l/i/n · minor · ረዓደ ሲኦል given without (?) in l and i though the note and published entry hedge it · (?) added; ch. 99 parallel cited.

### Unit 10
- 10 · l/i/n · moderate · አቢሶሙ ጥቀ was "I cannot parse"; it is the infinitive of አበሰ (pattern of ዐቂበ, ክሒደ) + -ሙ 'their sinning', with ጥቀ · l "their-sinning exceedingly(?)", i "In their great sinning (?) he did not spare them", note rewritten.
- 10 · i · minor · "put them under judgment" for ውስተ ደይን አንበሮሙ (2 Peter/Jude phrasing) · "set them in judgment"; the Apostle's words put in quotation marks as an ይቤ-citation.

### Unit 11
- 11 · l/i/n · major · ልሕኵቱ rendered 'slackness, weakness' and the clause "even though it was worked out through Adam's weakness" invented a concessive. ልሕኵት is 'moulded thing, creature' (ለሐከ; ልሕኵትየ in 100a unit 9; ch. 60 ላዕለ ልሕኵቱ after ተግባረ እደዊሁ; ch. 64 ቀዳሜ ልሕኵቱ ለእግዚኣብሔር of Adam) · l and i rebuilt: "the word that was zealous (?) for his moulded creature Adam", ተኬነወ aligned with 100a unit 9; note rewritten.
- 11 · l/i/n · moderate · ሞአ ቃለ: ቃለ carries the accusative/construct ending, so the clause strictly has no subject and the word is the object; the draft stated "the word of God prevailed" without flag · kept that reading for the sense but marked (?) in l and i, and stated the case problem in the note.
- 11 · n · moderate · "the Book of Enoch tells the same" (the navel-birth) — an unsupported claim · removed; only Genesis 6:4 compared.
- 11 · l/i/n · minor · ቦቶን anticipates አዋልደ ቀየን and the daughters are the subject of ፀንሳ; l/i blurred it · l/i/note restructured ("those who had gone astray with the women, the angels: the daughters of Cain conceived …").
- 11 · l/i/n · minor · ሠጢቆሙ is the infinitive of ሠጠቀ 'split' + -ሙ (cf. ተሠጥቀት, ch. 55), singular "womb of their mother" · "splitting the womb of their mother"; እንተ ሕንብርቲሆን marked 'by(?)' in l, explained in note.

### Unit 12
- 12 · l/i/n · moderate · አነኀ rendered 'made high … let his wrath rise (?)'. The root is ነኅ 'be long' (ከመ ይኑኅ መዋዕሊክሙ, ch. 90; ኑኆሙ is the same root) · "prolonged (?) his wrath".
- 12 · i/n · moderate · "shall not remain with them beyond 120 years" is Gen 6:3 as remembered; the Geʿez is ላዕሌሆሙ 'upon them' and ዘእንበለ 'except' · “… remain upon them except for 120 years”; the KJV quotation removed from the note.
- 12 · n · minor · ረዐይተ: added that ረዐይ- elsewhere is 'tend, shepherd' (ch. 98), so 'giants' is context only.

### Unit 15
- 15 · n · moderate · አይድዐኒ said to be from "አዶዐ"; the verb is አይድዐ (አይድዕኒ, ch. 32), and the -ኒ is 'me' · corrected.

### Unit 18
- 18 · i · minor · "make in it three compartments" for ላቲ 'for her' · "make for it".

### Unit 19
- 19 · l/i/n · moderate · ስምዑኒ glossed 'hear me then / now' with -ኒ 'then, now'; the published entry (and ch. 38, 62, 73) is 'hear me!' · corrected in l, i and note.
- 19 · l/i · minor · "for this reason" for ወበእንተ ዝ · "and concerning this".

### Unit 20
- 20 · l/i/n · major · ከመ አረፍት read as a verb 'be at rest, be still' in an "unusual form". አረፍት is a noun 'wall' (published entry; ch. 17 ቆመ ማይ ከመ አረፍት; ch. 55 አረፍት በይምን ወአረፍት በፅግም) · "to be like a wall" (the first draft's reading dropped).
- 20 · l/i/n · moderate · ያቈርር called "subjunctive of ቈረረ"; the ያ- is the causative አቈረረ (published entry; ያቈርር መዐቶ, ch. 62) · note corrected; "calm" → "cool" in l and i.
- 20 · i · minor · "wings like an eagle" (Isaiah/Rev. wording) for ክንፈ ከመ ንስር · "a wing like an eagle's".
- 20 · i · minor · "those he had chosen" for ፈቀደ (chosen is ኀረየ, unit 7) · "those he wished".

### Unit 22
- 22 · i · minor · ከመ በርባዔ is admitted in the note to be unsmooth, but i showed "by its fourfold shape" with no hedge · (?) added.

### Unit 25
- 25 · n · moderate · addressee left as "unnamed (?)". Grammar and concordance fix it: unit 24 (ለሙሴ … ይግበር), ምስለ እኁከ (Aaron), አዝዞሙ ለኵሉ ሕዝብ (the ch. 90 formula ወይቤሎ ለሙሴ አዝዞሙ; the published entry already says 'addressed to Moses'); plural 'you' from ወለእመ መጻእክሙ is the people · note rewritten; Noah excluded.
- 25 · l/i/n · moderate · ሡዕ taken as 'offer (from ሠዐ?)', possibly a noun. It is the 2nd singular imperative of ሠውዐ (ሡዕ ሊተ, ch. 12, 46, 51; published entry) · "sacrifice to me", (?) now only on the sense of ወንጹሕ በንጹሕ.
- 25 · i · moderate · "falsehood toward your brother, and your house also": ምስለ is 'with', not 'toward' · "together with your brother and your house".
- 25 · l/i · minor · (?) added to ግምንና 'abomination' (unattested elsewhere), to "in her", and to "receive it from you" (ለከ is a dative).

### Unit 26
- 26 · l/i/n · moderate · ዘተጋነይክሙ ሊተ: "devoted yourselves to me" is ungrammatical English and unsupported. ተጋነየ is a verb of prayer in the text (ch. 6, 9, 62) · "all that you have entreated of me (?)".
- 26 · l/i/n · moderate · ተቃጽቦ/ተሓምዮ are tä-stem reciprocal verbal nouns ('one another') · "without quarrelling (?) or slandering one another".
- 26 · n · moderate · ተኀሥሥ called "plural-sense imperative"; it is a 2nd singular form (published entry: imperfect) · corrected; kept as imperative (?).
- 26 · l/n · minor · (?) on ኣጽምእ (the usual 'give ear' verb has ዐ) and on "give ear"; ወአኀድር lemma is ኀደረ (ch. 1, 106), not አኀደረ; ኣንሶሱ labelled (አንሶሰወ); English quotation of Lev 26:12 removed from the note.

## Findings refused

- Quotation structure: God's speech opens in unit 0 and closes after ኢትዕድዉ እምቃልየ in unit 5 (correct); the Noah dialogue (units 14–18: God / Noah / God / Noah / God) is correctly alternated and closed; the second address opens at unit 25 and closes at the end of unit 27. No change needed. I did not move the unit 25 opening mark into unit 24 (it follows a reported command).
- Units 5 (58 words) and 20 (48 words) exceed ~45 words, but contain no ፤ to cut at; left whole as the drafter did.
- `t` untouched everywhere, including the split ኃጥ ኣን, አኀ ድር, and the nine ፨.
- 100a not edited. Left as a flag for its reviewer: 100a renders እበድ 'folly (?)', 100b 'madness'; ተኬነወ 'was zealous (?)' is now aligned across both parts.
- Gospel/epistle parallels in the notes (Luke 18:9–14, 16:15, 14:11; 2 Peter 2:4; Jude 6; Matthew 25:33; Exodus 27:2) kept: they are named as parallels and the English in `i` is not built from them.
- Not changed, accepted as grammatical: ተመክሑ, ትትዐቀቡ, ዘኢይትፈታሕ, ይሬስዮ, ፀንሳ/ስእና/ሞታ (3fpl), ኮኑ ረዐይተ structure, ድኂነ, ትከውኑኒ ('to me'), the numeral glosses.
- Did not re-derive the root of ተመክሑ (መክሐ/መከሐ) in the note: no conflict in the text.

## Readings still unresolved

- ተይ and መርቄ (unit 0): untranslated; cosmic/unplaced words, no sense from grammar.
- ምዝጋና (4): "glory (?)" only from the parallel with ሞገስ; unattested elsewhere.
- ይትዋሣእ (3): "dispute (?)" — reciprocal of the ወሥአ family; sense uncertain. በጽምሚት "silently (?)".
- ተኀየለ (2): passive 'overpowered' by parallel only; published entry differs.
- ተሠጥወ (4): 'yield' from context.
- ተሠርሙ, ወወረዲ (5): 'sent forth (?)', 'came down (?)'; endings irregular. ዘፍኖሙ 'dancing (?)'. ኪኖሙ ዘተኬነዉ 'craft … busied themselves (?)'. ይባቤ 'shouting (?)'.
- ተምዕዛ ሎሙ, አደማሆሙ (6): person/number fixed (3fpl), meanings guessed ('pleasing', 'stirred up').
- ረዓደ ሲኦል (9) 'terror (?)'.
- ሞአ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር (11): subject versus object (case ending against the chosen reading); ተኬነወ 'zealous (?)'.
- ረዐይተ (12) 'giants (?)', context only; አነኀ 'prolonged (?)'.
- ጽርባ (18): untranslated; no attestation elsewhere.
- ከመ በርባዔ (22): construction not smooth; 'fourfold shape (?)'.
- በይእቲ (25) 'in her (?)' and its relation to masculine እቄድሶ; ግምንና 'abomination (?)'; 'pure with pure' and 'receive it from you'.
- ተቃጽቦ 'quarrelling (?)'; ተጋነየ 'entreat (?)'; ኣፀምእ 'give ear (?)' (spelling with እ).
- ስላተ etc. in 100a are outside this pass.

## For the second pass (gloss.json)

Entries that must agree with the edits above: ሡዕ ሠውዐ; አረፍት 'wall'; ልሕኵቱ 'moulded thing'; ያቈርር አቈረረ; ስምዑኒ 'hear me'; ዘዘ distributive; እመሕያው; ተጋነይክሙ 'entreat' (?); ተኬነወ/ዘተኬነዉ one entry with 100a's; አቢሶሙ infinitive + -ሙ; ሠጢቆሙ infinitive of ሠጠቀ + -ሙ; ተኀየለ and ተሓምዮ/ተቃጽቦ (reciprocal); አይድዐኒ lemma አይድዐ; አኀ ድር lemma ኀደረ.
